examples.title: Example 1: Using the Same TransitionEffect Configuration for Image Appearance and Disappearance
examples.description: This example primarily demonstrates how to use the same TransitionEffect to achieve both the appearance and disappearance of an image, where the appearance and disappearance are inverse processes of each other.

examples.title: Example 2: Using Different TransitionEffect Configurations for Image Appearance and Disappearance
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use different TransitionEffect configurations to implement the appearance and disappearance of an image.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting transition on Parent and Child Components
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure transition on both parent and child components to implement the appearance and disappearance of images.
